item.title: Atlas Canyon by Lattafa – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Louis Vuitton Symphony
Type:
Price: 2.45 - 22.16 (5 variants)

Overview

Atlas Canyon is a 2026 flanker of Lattafa's Atlas: a bright, dry Eau de Parfum that opens with a sparkling burst of bergamot and lemon sharpened by fresh ginger, lifts into airy lily of the valley and sea notes, and dries down to clean ambroxan over earthy patchouli, oakmoss and soft musk. Lattafa files it as hesperidic ambery; reviewers describe it as a fresher, airier, less spicy take on the citrus-ginger style of Louis Vuitton Symphony.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Ginger, Bergamot, Lemon
Middle: Lily of the Valley, Sea Notes
Base: Ambroxan, Patchouli, Oakmoss, Musk

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, gym, everyday · Time: daytime

Try It Before You Commit

Every fragrance wears a little differently on skin. A decant lets you wear it several times, in different settings, before you commit to a full bottle.

item.title: Atlas Glacial Valley by Lattafa – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Creed Aventus
Type:
Price: 2.45 - 22.16 (5 variants)

Overview

Atlas Glacial Valley is a 2026 flanker of Lattafa's Atlas, and despite the icy name it wears warm: an Eau de Parfum that opens on juicy pineapple, green fig and a cool flick of mint, turns floral and faintly salty with jasmine and sea salt over patchouli, then settles into a sweet, mossy base of amber, vanilla and musk. Lattafa calls it an oriental marine; the pineapple-over-patchouli-and-moss structure puts it in the same fruity, mossy territory as Creed Aventus, softer and sweeter.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Fig, Mint, Pineapple
Middle: Jasmine, Sea Salt, Patchouli
Base: Amber, Vanilla, Musk, Moss

Best for

Season: Spring, fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Time: day or night

Try It Before You Commit

Every fragrance wears a little differently on skin. A decant lets you wear it several times, in different settings, before you commit to a full bottle.

item.title: Vantage by Rayhaan – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Amouage Decision
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Overview

Vantage by Rayhaan is a woody, spicy incense fragrance, an Eau de Parfum that opens with cardamom, bergamot and pink pepper before a resinous heart of frankincense, myrrh and juniper berries takes over. Cedarwood and patchouli give it a dry, structured finish with a smoky, balsamic glow.

Bold, aromatic and long-wearing, for women and men. Reviewers most often compare it to Amouage Decision, with several calling it a very close alternative.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cardamom, Bergamot, Pink Pepper
Middle: Frankincense, Myrrh, Juniper Berries
Base: Cedarwood, Patchouli

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, special occasions, evenings · Performance: long-lasting

item.title: Equinox by Rayhaan – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Maison Mataha Printemps Blanc
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Overview

Equinox by Rayhaan is a bright, polished white floral, an Eau de Parfum that opens on juicy grapefruit and orange blossom before settling into jasmine sambac and airy white tea. Creamy sandalwood and a soft touch of vanilla warm the dry-down without making it heavy.

Clean, luminous and easy to wear for women and men alike. Its note list matches Maison Mataha Printemps Blanc almost exactly, and retailers widely present it as an alternative to that scent; Rayhaan itself has not confirmed the link.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Grapefruit, Orange Blossom
Middle: Jasmine Sambac, White Tea
Base: Sandalwood, Vanilla

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, everyday, daytime

item.title: Silent Whisper by Mykonos – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Xerjoff Erba Gold
Type:
Price: 2.99 - 25.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Silent Whisper by Mykonos is a soft, fruity-musky Extrait de Parfum for women and men. Juicy fruit and bright citrus open it up, a gentle floral heart of ylang-ylang, jasmine and rose follows, and it settles into a creamy, powdery base of vanilla, amber, musk and soft woods. It is often compared to Xerjoff Erba Gold for its fruity, sweet-musky character.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Fruity Notes, Lemon, Mandarin, Bergamot
Middle: Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Rose
Base: Vanilla, Musk, Amber, Sandalwood, Cedarwood

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and early fall · Wear it: office, everyday, date night · Performance: long-lasting

Million Gold Intense is a men's Eau de Parfum Intense from Rabanne, a golden, woody take on the 1 Million idea. Bright mandarin and warm spice open onto creamy sandalwood and cedarwood. It is polished, confident and easy to wear.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Mandarin Orange
Middle: Spices
Base: Sandalwood, Cedarwood

Best for

Type:
Price: 3.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Montale's Intense Cafe is an Eau de Parfum that pairs rose with roasted coffee over a sweet vanilla and white musk base. It is rich, warm and gourmand with a powdery floral edge, and it carries a lot of presence. A little goes a long way.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Floral Notes
Middle: Rose, Coffee
Base: Vanilla, White Musk, Amber

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Performance: long-lasting, strong projection

item.title: Gentleman Society by Givenchy – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 3.99 - 26.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Gentleman Society is an Eau de Parfum from Givenchy, composed by Karine Dubreuil-Sereni and Maïa Lernout in 2023. Cardamom and sage open over a double vetiver and narcissus heart, drying down to creamy vanilla, palo santo and cedar. It is aromatic, woody and easy to wear.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cardamom, Sage
Middle: French Narcissus, Haitian Vetiver, Madagascar Vetiver
Base: Vanilla, Palo Santo, Cedar

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: office, date night

item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition

Overview

Sauvage Elixir is Dior's concentrated Elixir take on Sauvage, composed by François Demachy in 2021. A hit of cinnamon, nutmeg and cardamom opens over grapefruit, then a lavender heart settles into licorice, sandalwood and amber. It is warm, spicy and intense, made for cooler weather.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Nutmeg, Cinnamon, Cardamom, Grapefruit
Middle: Lavender
Base: Licorice, Sandalwood, Amber, Patchouli, Haitian Vetiver

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Performance: long-lasting

item.description:

Type:

Overview

Dior Homme Parfum is a Parfum from Dior, composed by François Demachy in 2014. A powdery Tuscan iris is wrapped in leather and rose, then dries down to sandalwood, cedar and a trace of oud. It is elegant, formal and grown-up.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Tuscan Iris, Italian Orange
Middle: Leather, Rose
Base: Sandalwood, Ambrette, Agarwood (Oud), Cedar

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, special occasions · Performance: long-lasting

item.title: Greenley by Parfums de Marly – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 5.99 - 31.49 (5 variants)

Overview

Greenley is a fresh, green and woody unisex Eau de Parfum from Parfums de Marly, composed by Nathalie Templer in 2020. Crisp green apple and Calabrian bergamot open onto a cedar, cashmeran and violet heart, drying down to oakmoss, musk and amberwood. Bright, polished and easy to wear.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Green Apple, Calabrian bergamot, Mandarin Orange
Middle: Petitgrain, Cedar, Cashmeran, Pomarose, Violet
Base: Oakmoss, Musk, Amberwood, Patchouli

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, everyday, gym · Performance: moderate projection

item.description:

Price: 5.49 - 30.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Ombre Leather is Tom Ford's iconic unisex leather, an Eau de Parfum from 2018 composed by Sonia Constant. Cardamom opens onto suede-like leather and jasmine sambac, resting on amber, moss and patchouli. Smooth, smoky and slightly animalic, it is a modern leather classic.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cardamom
Middle: Leather, Jasmine Sambac
Base: Amber, Moss, Patchouli

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Performance: long-lasting, strong projection

item.title: Noir Extreme by Tom Ford – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 4.99 - 29.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Noir Extreme is a warm, sweet oriental woody Eau de Parfum for men from Tom Ford, composed by Sonia Constant in 2015. It opens with cardamom, saffron and mandarin, melts into a creamy kulfi and orange blossom heart, and dries down to a rich vanilla, amber and sandalwood base. Dessert-like, spicy and built for cold evenings.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cardamom, Nutmeg, Saffron, Mandarin Orange, Neroli
Middle: Kulfi, Rose, Mastic or Lentisque, Orange Blossom, Jasmine
Base: Vanilla, Amber, Woody Notes, Sandalwood

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Performance: long-lasting, strong projection

Roses Vanille is a sweet, powdery rose-and-vanilla Eau de Parfum from Mancera, created by Pierre Montale in 2011 for women. A bright Italian lemon opens onto a Turkish rose heart, resting on warm vanilla, white musk and cedar.

Red Tobacco Intense is a darker, richer take on Mancera's Red Tobacco, an Extrait de Parfum from 2023 by Pierre Montale for women and men. Agarwood, cinnamon, incense and saffron open over a heart of tobacco, leather and patchouli, drying down to vanilla, musk, sandalwood and ambergris.

Middle: Tobacco, Leather, Patchouli, Vetiver, Jasmine

Instant Crush is a warm, spicy-floral Eau de Parfum from Mancera, created by Pierre Montale in 2019 for women and men. Saffron, ginger and sparkling Sicilian citrus open onto a rose and jasmine heart, then settle into a creamy vanilla, sandalwood and musk base with a touch of oakmoss.

Top: Saffron, Ginger, Sicilian Mandarin, Sicilian Bergamot
Middle: Amberwood, Moroccan Rose, Egyptian Jasmine, Indonesian Patchouli Leaf

item.title: Al Dirgham Special Edition by Ard Al Zaafaran – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Parfums de Marly Althair
Type: Eau de Parfum
Price: 1.99 - 34.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Al Dirgham Special Edition by Ard Al Zaafaran is an Eau de Parfum from the Dubai house's 2023 limited run, a warm, sweet oriental spicy scent with a distinctly gourmand, nutty-vanilla character. It opens on cinnamon and nutmeg, softens into cardamom and a fruity heart, and dries down into creamy vanilla and pistachio over a spiced base. Marketed as unisex, it is a cosy cold-weather scent that reviewers often compare to the Althair style of vanilla-spice gourmands.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cinnamon, Nutmeg
Middle: Cardamom, Fruity Notes
Base: Vanilla, Pistachio, Spices

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Performance: long-lasting

item.title: Kenzo Homme Eau de Parfum by Kenzo – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 3.99 - 32.00 (5 variants)

The original, not a tribute to one. Quentin Bisch built Kenzo Homme Eau de Parfum on three ideas and nothing else — sea notes, leather and patchouli — and the restraint is the point. It opens salty and ozonic, turns supple and animalic as the leather arrives, and dries down earthy. One of the more distinctive marine fragrances a designer house has put out.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Sea Notes
Middle: Leather
Base: Patchouli

item.title: Gas by Bujairami – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Creed Aventus Cologne
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 22.50 (5 variants)

Gas is Bujairami's run at Aventus Cologne, and the pyramid tracks it closely — pink pepper and ginger over citrus, a woody heart of sandalwood, patchouli and vetiver, then tonka, styrax and birch underneath. Fresh and spicy at the opening, drier and woodier as it settles. Composed by Adam Bujairami.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Pink Pepper, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Spearmint, Ginger
Middle: Ozonic Notes, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Vetiver
Base: Tonka Bean, Styrax, Cedar, Birch, Musk

item.title: Milk Drops by Mykonos – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 2.45 - 22.16 (5 variants)

Milk Drops is the lactonic one in Mykonos's Drops line. Milk, caramel and vanilla up front give it a soft powdery sweetness, tea and almond keep it from going flat, and sandalwood, cedar and musk take it into a skin-like drydown. Comforting and close to the skin rather than a projector — reviewers call it powdery first and sweet second.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Milk, Vanilla, Caramel
Middle: Tea, Rose, Almond
Base: Musk, Vanilla, Sandalwood, Cedarwood

item.title: Infina by Maison Asrar – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 2.45 - 22.16 (5 variants)

Infina is Maison Asrar's woody marine. Pink pepper, cardamom and bergamot open sharp over a cool sea-air accord, then smoky incense and cashmere woods move in underneath. It finishes mossy and musky rather than clean-fresh, which is what separates it from the usual aquatic.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Pink Pepper, Marine Accord, Cardamom, Bergamot
Middle: Cashmere Wood, Incense, Amber
Base: Musk, Amber, Moss

item.title: Veyra by Maison Asrar – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 2.45 - 22.16 (5 variants)

Veyra is a fruity floral with a gourmand streak running through it. Pomegranate, blackcurrant and mandarin give it a juicy opening, Bulgarian rose and magnolia carry the middle, and a caramel facet warms it before peach, vanilla and ambergris settle in. Bright at the top, creamy underneath.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Pomegranate, Blackcurrant, Bergamot, Mandarin
Middle: Caramel, Lily of the Valley, Magnolia, Bulgarian Rose
Base: Peach, Vanilla, Ambrette, Ambergris

item.title: Vanilla Seduction by Maison Asrar – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Vanilla Seduction is the darker, fruitier half of Maison Asrar's vanilla pair. Plum and jasmine open it, brown sugar and caramel thicken the middle, and a trail of tonka, amber and patchouli keeps it from turning into dessert. Warm and close-wearing rather than loud.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Plum, Jasmine, Lily of the Valley
Middle: Vanilla, Brown Sugar, Caramel
Base: Tonka, Amber, Patchouli, Musk

item.title: Replica By the Fireplace by Maison Margiela – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 3.99 - 32.00 (5 variants)

The original, not a tribute to one. Maison Margiela's Replica By the Fireplace bottles the smell of a log fire in winter: clove and pink pepper crackling over roasted chestnut, guaiac wood and juniper smoke, settling into vanilla, Peru balsam and soft cashmeran. Composed by Marie Salamagne in 2015, it is the reference point a whole generation of cosy-smoky fragrances has been chasing.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cloves, Pink Pepper, Orange Blossom
Middle: Chestnut, Guaiac Wood, Juniper
Base: Vanilla, Peru Balsam, Cashmeran

item.title: Vanilla Aura by Maison Asrar – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Guerlain Vanille Planifolia
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Vanilla Aura is Maison Asrar's much-talked-about take on a grown-up vanilla. Lemon and bergamot open it bright, a creamy heart of caramel, chocolate and vanilla fills in behind, and it dries down into amber, sandalwood and tonka. It reads ambery and resinous rather than sugary-edible, and the longevity is what people keep writing home about.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Lily of the Valley, Bergamot, Lemon
Middle: Vanilla, Chocolate, Caramel
Base: Vanilla, Amber, Sandalwood, Tonka
